note: Every example here is unedited model output from a live generation session on the public site, kept exactly as submitted. Fixtures (in fixtures/) are the opposite: specification- or tool-created bytes.

examples.title: Platform game
examples.prompt: build a good looking version of a clone of super mario brothers where i can jump around, make all the pixels so it looks like super marios world. mario should be able to move with direction keys, and space bar to jump

annotations.summary: A colorful platform scene with a controllable red-cap hero. Left/right move across the screen; Space raises the hero and release lets him descend. Sky, ground, cloud, and green pipe are redrawn each frame.

examples.title: Platform game (an earlier attempt)
examples.prompt: build a good looking version of a clone of super mario brothers where i can jump around, make all the pixels so it looks like super marios world. mario should be able to move with direction keys, and space bar to jump

annotations.summary: A looping pixel-art platform scene: a blue sky with cloud, brick ledge, pipe and grassy floor; a chunky red, skin-tone and blue Mario moves left/right and rises while Space is held. Frames are drawn with nested pixel loops and presented before waiting for the next tick.
